H_protocol: H1 literal source-compatible acts; H2 actual amplification with stated intensity limits; H3 behavior too local-punchline-bound to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Fantasy, deception, performance, survival, unknown cause and uncertain motive are not automatic H3/H4. Comic framing does not erase harm.
L_protocol: L0 portable proposition; L1 material phrasing/rhythm; L2 pragmatics/register/recipient force; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction or annotation. Ordinary idiom, cultural script, ruby, name or spell label alone does not establish L3.
